name: gta
description: A top-down, GTA-style open-world browser game where **every character is a faceless mannequin** — smooth blank beige heads, no eyes, no mouth, nothing. You, the pedestrians, the cops, the soldiers: nobody here has a face. But they're not all the same man — the streets are full of different faceless men: suits, hoodies, hi-vis workers, tracksuits, joggers, all with different builds and walks.
